rules.description: The foundational dark ink used for primary typography, dominant brand actions, and logos.
when_to_use: Body typography and large hero headings

rules.description: The core surface palette, defining the page foundation and lifting interactive components through crisp backgrounds and borders.
when_to_use: Dropdown menu and secondary button surfaces (#FFFFFF)

rules.description: A muted gray that establishes typographic hierarchy, receding secondary information behind the primary black text.
when_to_use: Secondary descriptive text in feature sections

rules.description: A vibrant blue reserved strictly for accessibility indicators and highly specific illustration highlights.
when_to_use: 'Skip to content' focus ring and text
Gradient stop in the 'Passport' feature card illustration

rules.description: A pitch black deployed almost entirely as an alpha-channel base for drop shadows and delicate structural borders.
when_to_use: Translucent borders on dropdown menus and feature cards
Drop shadows lifting sticky headers and navigation panels

insights: High-Contrast Monochromatic Core: The design relies heavily on a stark black-and-white foundation, using Ink Black for heavy text and CTAs against bright whites to keep the UI sleek and highly legible.

Restrained Color Usage: Vibrant hues like the Accent Blue are extremely limited, ensuring the content, partner logos, and specific feature illustrations command attention without competing against the UI.

Alpha-Driven Depth: Rather than relying on solid gray backgrounds to separate sections, the design builds depth through layered white surfaces accented with subtle, translucent black borders and shadows.
